pflegefachkraft-intensivpflege.title: Nursing Specialist – Out-of-Hospital Intensive Care (m/f/d)
pflegefachkraft-intensivpflege.claim: Care with time. With responsibility. With appreciation.
intro: Do you want to support people at a high professional level while working in an environment where your performance is truly seen? Then KSK Farmos is the right place for you.

With us you care for people in their own home or in an intensive care shared flat. You work in a calm atmosphere, without the hectic routine of a hospital ward, and with the freedom to deliver care the way it should be: professional, attentive and humane.
pflegefachkraft-intensivpflege.benefitsTitle: What you can look forward to

benefits.title: Above-tariff pay
benefits.text: Good care deserves more than recognition. That is why we offer an above-average salary that reflects your responsibility, commitment and qualifications.

benefits.title: Working hours that fit your life
benefits.text: Your life is more than work. That is why we rely on individual shift planning instead of rigid standard models. Together we find working hours that fit your everyday life.

benefits.title: Support with your commute
benefits.text: We want you to arrive at work relaxed. Depending on the place of work, we offer a shuttle service and help you get to your workplace reliably.

benefits.title: A team that sticks together
benefits.text: We believe good care is only possible in a strong team. Mutual support, honest communication and respectful treatment are not empty phrases for us but everyday practice.

benefits.title: Meaningful and demanding care
benefits.text: You work with people who depend on intensive, specialised care. You take on responsible tasks in treatment and basic care and often accompany clients over a longer period.

benefits.title: Further training with real value
benefits.text: We invest in your knowledge. Regular internal training and further education help you stay professionally confident and keep developing.

benefits.title: An employer with a future
benefits.text: KSK Farmos is growing steadily. For you that means security, development opportunities and a long-term perspective in a modern care company.

requirements: Completed training as a nursing specialist, geriatric nurse or healthcare and nursing professional
Empathy, a sense of responsibility and joy in working with people
A structured and reliable way of working

nice: Further training in intensive care, hygiene or respiratory therapy
pflegefachkraft-intensivpflege.niceNote: If not: no problem. We will support you along the way.
pflegefachkraft-intensivpflege.closingText: Do you want to have the time that good care needs again? Are you looking for a team that sticks together, fair working conditions and an employer with a future? Then we look forward to getting to know you.
